title: Google Earth map of Loring AFB, Limestone Maine and Grand Falls NB area
description: Attachment 5 (page 41): a Google Earth satellite map of the Maine/New Brunswick border region with placemarks including Loring AFB 9/75, Limestone ME and Grand Falls NB. Yellow road overlays, Route 130 shields and Google navigation controls are visible, relating to the September 1975 Loring AFB intrusions.
